## What's new
- **Closing the last window now quits Renderooo**, so the app no longer stays in the Dock with nothing open. If you were editing, your changes are saved before it quits.

## Install
1. Download **Renderooo-1.0.2-macOS.zip** below, unzip, and move **Renderooo.app** to Applications.
2. The app isn't notarized, so macOS blocks it the first time: try to open it, then go to **System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Open Anyway**. Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Renderooo.app`.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Universal (Apple silicon + Intel).
